groups.title: Container Architecture
groups.question: Explain what a container really is under the hood and how you would write a good image for one.

followUps.Containers vs Virtual Machines: Why does sharing the host kernel make containers lighter than VMs, and what security risk does that bring?
followUps.Dockerfile Best Practices and Layer Cach: Why does the order of instructions in a Dockerfile change how fast your rebuilds are?

groups.title: Multi-Stage Builds
groups.question: Walk through how you would build a small, safe production image for a compiled app.

followUps.Why Multi-Stage Builds Matter: Why does a smaller final image usually mean fewer vulnerabilities, not just faster pulls?
followUps.Container Image Security Scanning: Why should you keep scanning images that already passed a scan when they were built?

groups.title: Docker Compose for Local Development
groups.question: Explain how you would set up a reproducible local environment with several services and how they talk to each other.

followUps.Defining Multi-Service Stacks with Compo: How does keeping the whole stack in one Compose file help a new team member get started?
followUps.Docker Networking Modes: When would you pick host networking over a bridge network, and what do you give up?

groups.title: Container Registry and Image Management
groups.question: Explain how you would store, version and ship images, and how you handle data that must outlive a container.

followUps.Pushing and Tagging Images in a Registry: Why is relying on the latest tag in production risky, and what tagging scheme would you use instead?
followUps.Docker Volumes and Data Persistence: What happens to data written inside a container when it is removed, and why prefer named volumes over bind mounts in production?
